sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Candy Bounce are simple yet engaging. Players control a character who is bouncing a ball on a basketball court. The game requires a combination of timing, accuracy, and strategy to succeed. Players need to time their bounces perfectly to score points, while also avoiding obstacles and challenges that can hinder their progress.

One of the key mechanics in Candy Bounce is the use of power-ups. These power-ups can be collected by bouncing the ball into special areas on the court. They can provide temporary advantages, such as increased speed, accuracy, and score multiplier. Power-ups can be a game-changer, especially in difficult levels, and players need to use them strategically to succeed.

Another important aspect of Candy Bounce is the court itself. The court is divided into different sections, each with its own challenges and obstacles. With its simple yet engaging gameplay, Candy Bounce is a game that can be enjoyed by players of all ages and skill levels.
